_comment: Real Kalshi production data fetched read-only on 2026-07-21 for parser tests (see docs/adr/0005-settlement-resolution.md). Verbatim except formatting.

KXHIGHNY-26JUL21-T79.title: Will the **high temp in NYC** be <79° on Jul 21, 2026?
KXHIGHNY-26JUL21-T79.rules_primary: If the highest temperature recorded in Central Park, New York for July 21, 2026 as reported by the National Weather Service's Climatological Report (Daily), is less than 79°, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXLOWTNYC-26JUL20-T67.title: Will the minimum temperature be >67° on Jul 20, 2026?
KXLOWTNYC-26JUL20-T67.rules_primary: If the minimum temperature recorded at New York City for Jul 20, 2026, is greater than 67° fahrenheit according to the National Weather Service's Climatological Report (Daily), then the market resolves to Yes.
